high_level_description: This image is a screenshot from an Instagram post by the account "tech_on_air." The post features an illustration of a large, futuristic structure with glowing blue elements, likely representing a particle accelerator or a similar scientific device. The text overlay on the image reads: "Cherenkov's Radiation" The accompanying description explains that when a charged particle such as an electron passes through a dielectric medium at a greater speed than the light's one (which is possible), it emits blue radiation known as Cherenkov's Radiation. The post has received 2,850 likes.
